analysis.executiveSummary: In this submitted offer, Corgi Loaf Baking Co. proposes sending WR DJ Moore and RB Saquon Barkley to Mile High Royal Lions in exchange for WR Garrett Wilson. From a neutral perspective, Corgi Loaf gains significant starting lineup value (+19.9 C-AVI) by upgrading FLEX1 with Garrett Wilson and forming a elite young wide receiver trio alongside Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Malik Nabers. Conversely, Mile High Royal Lions suffers a net starting lineup downgrade of -15.1 C-AVI, as replacing Garrett Wilson with DJ Moore at WR2 drops that slot by -25.7 C-AVI, which is only partially offset by inserting Saquon Barkley into FLEX2. Because this starting lineup reduction directly conflicts with Mile High's stated objective to Increase Playoff Odds, the submitted offer is unlikely to be accepted as constructed and requires revision with additional draft capital.

submitted.summary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. secures an elite 26-year-old cornerstone receiver in Garrett Wilson, boosting starting lineup C-AVI by +19.9 points and solidifying a premier long-term receiver corps. Mile High Royal Lions surrenders a true WR1 for two 29-year-old starters, suffering a net -15.1 C-AVI starting lineup downgrade that hurts their immediate push to increase playoff odds.
